brief_v2.history_line: Website launched Sep 5 · Website video reworked with real footage

performance.verdict: ROAS structural drop masks one strong day; efficiency is fragmenting, not collapsing.

findings.text: ROAS fell 69.61% week-over-week; 3-day purchases (Sep 8–10): 5+0+1=6 vs prior 3 (Sep 5–7): 1+1+2=4 — slight uptick but revenue wildly uneven ($951 vs $520), driven by one $500 day.
Spend rose 25.69% to ~$57.88/day while purchases averaged 1.4/day across 28 days (36 purchases / 28 days); revenue-per-dollar is compressing unevenly with no purchase on 15 of 28 days.
4 OVERDUE MILESTONES past Aug 31: Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — all blocking attribution integrity and scaling confidence.

Live-Cooking Event (Shoot 1) overdue since Aug 14; real facility footage was delivered Jul 21 but 10 product-creative tasks remain open — creative pipeline is the binding constraint on audience refresh.
GBP actions hit 0 for Sep 6–9 (4 consecutive zero days) after averaging 28/day in prior weeks; organic local intent signal has gone dark — not an ads problem but removes a conversion floor.

suggestions.text: Hold Meta spend flat at ~$50/day; watch purchases over next 3 days before any scale — ROAS floor unconfirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend is running ~$57.88/day with a 69.61% ROAS decline week-over-week and purchases on only 13 of 28 days. Hold daily budget flat — do not scale 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' until 3 consecutive purchase days are confirmed. Success check: 3+ purchases in the window Sep 12–14. Re-evaluate Sep 15.

suggestions.text: Escalate Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live milestone (overdue Aug 31) — attribution gap is blocking ROAS read reliability.
suggestions.monday_update: The Funnel Test (100% off code ihbp8pmtn8) and UTM live milestone were due Aug 31 and remain open. Without UTMs firing consistently, the 4.84 ROAS figure cannot be trusted as a scaling signal — Shopify undercounts and Meta overcounts are both unresolved. Owner: Khurram (Ads board). Success check: UTM parameter confirmed firing on all Meta traffic by Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP dark period (0 actions Sep 6–9); confirm profile not suspended or miscategorised before organic floor erodes further.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for at least 4 consecutive days (Sep 6–9) after a 28-action/day average — this is a hard stop in local intent signals, not a gradual fade. Check Google Business Profile for suspension notice, category changes, or review flags. Success check: daily GBP actions return above 15 by Sep 14. Owner: Nacer (Ops).
